description: Change a planting's status (active/finished/failed), notes, quantity, transplant date, variety, or MOVE it to another bed (pass bed with the target bed's name — history stays attached; any layout position is cleared, re-place with place_planting). Identify the planting by plant name or plantingId.

bed.description: Move the planting to this bed (by name).

garden.description: Garden name; defaults to the user's first garden.

plant.description: Plant name of the planting to update.

transplantedAt.description: ISO date the seedling went into the bed.

name: update_planting
title: Update a planting
